Clean one text column; optional parsed HTML preserves source text, entities and paragraph boundaries.

**Status:** Runs. In the palette under **Advanced operations > Text**.

Legacy mode keeps existing behavior. Parsed HTML requires Remove HTML on, Lowercase and special-character normalization off. Appends cleaned text, HTML title and versioned policy; original columns remain unchanged. Optional paired comment markers exclude surrounding navigation. No scripts are executed or URLs fetched.

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| text_column | `text_column` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Text column. |
| lowercase | `lowercase` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Lowercase text. |
| remove_html | `remove_html` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Remove HTML tags. |
| html_mode | `html_mode` | Choice | `legacy_tags` | `legacy_tags`, `parsed_html` | The run | HTML handling: legacy tag regex or optional parsed body with entities and paragraph boundaries. |
| html_begin_comment | `html_begin_comment` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Parsed HTML: exact opening comment text (without delimiters); supply both markers or neither. |
| html_end_comment | `html_end_comment` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Parsed HTML: exact closing comment text; missing/duplicate markers fail. |
| remove_special_chars | `remove_special_chars` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Remove punctuation and symbols (letters and digits of every script stay) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
